answer: A burst of registrations hence prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The reef multiplier is published, charged in nectar, and jetty lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 14 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 3500 identities would post 3270 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
